_hinweis: Buchgerüst EXO (scripts/authoring/buchgeruest.py aus buch/EXO.json). Form je Station: «szene» wird gemalt und automatisch geprüft, «struktur» zeichnet das Werkzeug aus den Elementen. Vorläufig von oben; Band ist ein Titel in eigenen Worten.

figuren.FIG-MOSE: Moses: an old man with long white hair and a full white beard, a weathered, earnest face; a cream tunic under a plain earth-brown mantle without stripes, a leather belt; a long plain wooden shepherd's staff. No horns, no rays or glow around his head; no stone tablets unless the scene names them.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-ISRAEL: The Israelites: men and women of different ages in light undyed robes with blue mantles, the women with plain pale head cloths; dignified, never caricatured; further figures behind only as loose outlines; no child in front.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-DORNBUSCH: A low thorny desert bush with small green leaves, burning with a few loose orange-red flames while its branches and leaves stay green and whole; no face or figure in the fire, no glow around it.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-SCHAF: Three sheep with pale fleece and dark faces, grazing.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-SANDALE: A pair of plain leather sandals lying on the sand.
figuren.FIG-ORT-BERG: A mountain: a broad, bare hilltop with a few rocks, drawn with a few lines and one pale olive wash.
figuren.FIG-ORT-MEER: The sea divided: two tall walls of blue-green water with loose wave crests, a dry pale sand path between them.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-WOLKE: The cloud of God's presence: a dense, soft grey-white cloud painted as a plain wash – standing on the ground as a tall column, or resting on a tent; no glow, no rays, no figure or face in it.
figuren.FIG-ORT-ZELT-BEGEGNUNG: The tent of meeting (tabernacle): a long low tent with dark goat-hair coverings, standing inside a rectangular courtyard of white linen curtains hung on wooden posts, an entrance curtain at the front.
figuren.FIG-ORT-WUESTE: The Sinai desert: pale sand ground with a few rocks, small tents of the camp drawn with a few lines.
figuren.FIG-ORT-NIL-ROT: The Nile in Egypt: a broad river between banks of reeds and papyrus, its water turned an opaque dark rust-red and undrinkable; no dead animals shown.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-FROESCHE: Frogs: many small green and brown frogs sitting on the ground and on a clay pot, simple and not ugly.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-STECHMUECKEN: Gnats: a thin grey cloud of countless tiny gnats hovering low over dusty ground.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-STECHFLIEGEN: Flies: a dense dark swarm of flies buzzing around a doorway, drawn as small dark specks with tiny wings.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-KAMEL: A camel: a sand-brown one-humped camel standing in side view, with a plain striped saddle cloth.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-KRANK: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a person lying on a simple mat under a light blanket, eyes closed, a pale face, a few faint wavy lines of fever above.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-HAGEL: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a heavy dark storm cloud with round white hailstones falling on a field of flattened green barley.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-FINSTERNIS: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: an almost black cloud with grey swirls in it; no light.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-FREIHEIT: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a small bird flying up, below it a broken chain.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-GOETZEN: Idols of other gods: several small figurines of clay, wood and bronze of different shapes standing in a row on a stone ledge.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-NICHT: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a red circle with a diagonal bar, empty inside.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-GOETZENBILD: A small gold-brown statuette of a standing figure on a low stone pedestal; no specific deity, no recognisable religion.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-SCHWOEREN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a raised right hand, palm forward, beside a small rolled scroll tied with a cord.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-EHE: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a man and a woman standing side by side, both in plain robes, with a small red heart between them.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-DIEB: A thief: a man in a dark grey hooded cloak climbing over a low wall with a sack in his hand; not caricatured.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-LUEGE: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a red X in a pale circle, on white paper.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-GOLDENES-KALB: The golden calf: a young bull calf cast in gold, standing stiffly on a low stone base; plain, without decoration.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-BETEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: two hands folded in prayer, palms together, painted in warm skin tones.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-GESETZESTAFELN: Two stone tablets with rounded tops, side by side, with plain line strokes instead of writing; no numbers, no letters.

bilder.note_de: Sechs Stationen ([[EXO.3.1-EXO.40.38]]). Gemalt sind drei Szenen: die Berufung am Dornbusch, der Weg durchs Meer und die Wolke über dem fertigen Heiligtum; Plagen, Zehn Worte und die Fürbitten nach dem goldenen Kalb sind Strukturbilder. Gott wird nie gemalt; das Gericht an den Ägyptern im Meer ([[EXO.14.27-EXO.14.28]]) steht nur im Text, und dass der Pharao sein Herz verhärtet und Gott es verhärtet, bleibt beides stehen ([[EXO.8.15]], [[EXO.9.12]]).

EXO-B1.bild_en: The wilderness at the foot of Mount Horeb, Sinai, in the Late Bronze Age (traditional setting). On the RIGHT a low thorny desert bush burns with a few loose orange-red flames, yet its branches and small leaves stay green and whole. On the LEFT Moses – an old man with long white hair and a full white beard, a cream tunic and a plain earth-brown mantle – kneels barefoot on the sand, his sandals lying beside him and his long staff on the ground. He turns his face half away and shields his eyes with the crook of one arm, his back bowed in awe and fear; his white beard stays visible. Behind him three sheep graze. One grey line for the mountain ridge. No figure or face in the fire, no glow, no rays. Medium-wide shot, the upper third empty paper.

evidence.de: Der Busch brennt im Feuer und wird doch nicht verzehrt.
Zieh deine Sandalen aus, denn der Ort ist heiliger Boden.
Mose verhüllt sein Gesicht, denn er fürchtet sich, Gott anzuschauen.
Mose hütet die Schafe Jitros am Gottesberg Horeb.
Gott hat das Elend seines Volkes gesehen und sendet Mose zum Pharao.
Zeit und Ort nach der Überlieferung; Arm vor den Augen als sichtbare Form des Verhüllens.

EXO-B2.form_grund_de: Reihe gleichartiger Glieder mit wiederkehrenden Formeln; alle Glieder stehen da, der letzte Schlag ist abgehoben (Strukturkatalog: Plagen 3 × 3 + 1, numbered; die Gruppierung ist Beobachtung der Auslegung, der Text zählt nicht).

evidence.de: Das Wasser des Nils wird zu Blut.
Um Mitternacht stirbt jeder Erstgeborene in Ägypten.
Wo das Blut an den Häusern ist, geht der Schlag vorüber.
Der Pharao lässt das Volk ziehen.
Die Gliederung in dreimal drei Schläge und einen letzten ist eine Beobachtung der Auslegung (Strukturkatalog).

EXO-B3.form_grund_de: Die Rettungserzählung gipfelt in einem sichtbaren Augenblick ([[EXO.14.21-EXO.14.22]]).
EXO-B3.bild_en: The sea at the edge of Egypt in the Late Bronze Age (traditional setting), early morning. In the CENTRE a dry, pale sand path runs through the sea between two tall walls of blue-green water that reach just below the upper third. Along it the Israelites – men and women of different ages in light robes with blue mantles, carrying bundles and kneading bowls, leading a few sheep – walk from LEFT to RIGHT, hurried but upright, some glancing up at the water walls. On the LEFT, on a low rock at the shore, Moses – an old man with a long white beard in a plain earth-brown mantle – stands with his arm and his long staff stretched out over the sea. On the far LEFT behind him a tall column of grey-white cloud stands on the ground. No soldiers, no chariots, nobody drowning; no light effects. Medium-wide shot.

evidence.de: Mose streckt seine Hand über das Meer aus, und das Wasser teilt sich.
Die Israeliten gehen auf dem Trockenen mitten ins Meer; das Wasser ist ihnen eine Mauer zur Rechten und zur Linken.
Die Wolkensäule tritt hinter sie, zwischen das Lager Ägyptens und das Lager Israels.
Erhebe deinen Stab und strecke deine Hand über das Meer.
Das Volk trägt seinen Teig in Backschüsseln mit.
Das Heer der Ägypter und ihr Untergang ([[EXO.14.27-EXO.14.28]]) werden nicht gemalt.

Die Zählung der zehn Worte ist in den Traditionen verschieden; das Bild nummeriert nicht.

EXO-B6.form_grund_de: Das Buch schliesst mit einer erzählten Szene ([[EXO.40.34-EXO.40.35]]): Gott wohnt in der Mitte seines Volkes.
EXO-B6.bild_en: The camp of Israel in the Sinai desert, Late Bronze Age (traditional setting). In the CENTRE stands the newly erected tent of meeting: a long low tent with dark goat-hair coverings inside a rectangular courtyard of white linen curtains on wooden posts. A dense, soft grey-white cloud rests on the tent and covers it. On the LEFT, outside the courtyard entrance, Moses – an old man with a long white beard in a plain earth-brown mantle, his staff in hand – has stopped and stepped back, one open hand half raised in awe; he does not go in. On the RIGHT a few Israelites in light robes with blue mantles, men and women, stand among small tents and look towards the cloud, two of them kneeling. No glow, no rays. Medium-wide shot, the upper third empty paper.

evidence.de: Die Wolke bedeckt das Zelt der Begegnung, und die Herrlichkeit JHWHs erfüllt die Wohnung.
Mose kann nicht in das Zelt der Begegnung hineingehen.
Mose richtet den Vorhof rings um die Wohnung auf.
Hebt sich die Wolke, bricht Israel auf; das Buch endet unterwegs.
Zuschauende Israeliten und ihre Zelte: plausible Ausgestaltung.
Die Herrlichkeit wird nicht als Licht gemalt; sichtbar ist nur die Wolke.
